scope: Independent arithmetic and visual review of the native-image lattice and supporting local central-photo transforms. This does not approve exact collectible/structure coordinates, game units, official semantics, or a new live release.

native_affine.method: Solved (A^T A) B = A^T X from the 19 frozen fit observations, independently of the producing lstsq implementation; then projected the ten outer and ten interior reserved observations.

sensitivity_check.model: Separate horizontal and vertical scale/offset with zero shear, fitted to the same19 fit observations.
sensitivity_check.conclusion: The small shear terms are not necessary to obtain similar observed residuals. This supports a stable lattice reference rather than proving the fine affine coefficients are physical constants.

local_photo_registration.independent_method: Normalized direct linear transform from the frozen inlier correspondences, followed by SciPy nonlinear least-squares minimization of forward reprojection error. Recomputed reserved-cross projections and convex hull membership; also refitted after deduplicating source locations rounded to0.01px.
local_photo_registration.conclusion: The independent refits corroborate the reported local transforms. Within-hull cross residuals stay near1native pixel for the centre/north photo and near5photo26 pixels for the photo-pair overlap. Extrapolated centre/north cross error reaches about9native pixels; the local transform must not be extended into an exact global marker-placement method.

inspected: reviewer-created crop sheet of all10outer and10interior holdouts from the unchanged native image
visual_review.outer_crosses: All29 selected outer panels show the repeating cross pattern. Several are faint/JPEG-soft; the observed integer-pixel centres do not imply subpixel certainty.
visual_review.interior_crosses: The10 accepted interior candidates show visible plus-shaped marks, distinct from surrounding road/building edges. Rejected diagnostic candidates include icons, corners or obscured markings and are not counted as check evidence.
visual_review.central_photo: The original-photo cross sheet and architectural feature montage support the central correspondence without an apparent whole-cell alias. Numeric checks, not the montage alone, control the residual claims.

corrections_verified.finding: Two photo source paths initially named metadata-stripped AT343 files while listing exact-original hashes.
corrections_verified.resolution: Packet now names the exact AT344 original paths and lists the AT343 pixel-identical versions separately. All three source path/hash/dimension checks pass.

corrections_verified.finding: A1 was initially described as an observed crossing although index[0,0] was not one of the29 measured samples.
corrections_verified.resolution: Final config describes A1 as the model-defined northwest reference crossing.

domain_review.labelled_cell_domain: 18columns by18rows, clipped to image; bottom/right partial cells and unlabelled pre-origin top/left strips are intentional conventions.
domain_review.limitation: Measured native observations reach row15 (~1663px); the reference grid extends to lower rows. Bottom-edge attempts did not yield defensible additional observations. The whole-image overlay is an Atlas coordinate convention, with alignment residuals certified only for the recorded samples and no universal error bound.
domain_review.fit_independence_limit: The reserved nodes are absent from the fit, but the exploratory candidate search used approximate lattice positions. Interior acceptance followed visual inspection of34crops. These are observed alignment checks, not blind/preregistered citywide accuracy estimates.

release_conditions: Preserve the exact existing native map bytes/hash and expose the grid as an optional Atlas-owned reference layer.
Keep the model-defined origin/cell convention distinct from the earlier Wild Zone20 local A1 convention and official game coordinates.
Do not label sixty as verified feet/metres/counted steps per cell or infer an item/structure from a cross.
Retain original marker coordinates, source confidence, floor/access evidence and near-boundary ambiguity; fractional formatting does not improve location accuracy.
Keep the measured-region/error qualifications when presenting calibration results, including lower-edge extrapolation.
Complete independent runtime, exact-head CI, phone/desktop and release verification before promotion.
